proposal.reason: Main change is in symmetric-memory collective OKI kernels: src/collectives/device/symmetric/ce_kernel_oki.cuh now sizes reduce DMA by remaining elements per iteration and caps broadcast pre-copy to local-rank elements, and src/collectives/device/symmetric/oki_utils.cuh plus p2p_dma_oki.cuh adjust per-die lane byte splitting/usage to avoid zero-byte lane fencing. This is symmetric-specific collective kernel behavior (including its CE path details), so symmetric takes priority over broader CE/DMA candidates.
